{% set name = "mypy-boto3-batch" %}
{% set version = "1.35.0" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.io/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/{{ name.replace('-', '_') }}-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 2d5c127c3965ec7d31c6f17a6f6c25aabfe04399d1e28aad7afe194f8860257d

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . --no-deps -vv

requirements:
  host:
    - pip
    - python >=3
  run:
    - python >=3
    - typing_extensions
    - botocore

test:
  imports:
    - mypy_boto3_batch
